ui.badge: Independent · not affiliated with any candidate

welcome.title: Find the candidate who speaks for you
welcome.sub: A few short questions on the issues you care about — then a candidate list ranked by how well they match. Fully transparent: you always see why.
welcome.privacy: The questionnaire is completely anonymous — your answers and results stay in your browser only and are never collected anywhere.
welcome.browse: Just browse the candidates, skip the questionnaire

steps.title: Answer honestly
steps.desc: Drag, rate and select what feels closest to you.

steps.title: We compare
steps.desc: Your answers are weighed against candidate positions.

steps.title: Transparent ranking
steps.desc: Every match comes with a full explanation.

quiz.dragHint: Drag the slider to your position

results.title: Your best matches
results.sub: Ordered by match. Tap a candidate for details, or open the explanation.
results.aiNotice: Candidate positions were researched with AI and may contain errors. Open a candidate to see the evidence behind each one.

viewNote.balanced: The same candidates, alternating between women and men. No score changed — only the order.
viewNote.close: The {count} candidates closest to your positions, in random order. Pick by instinct rather than by a decimal point. Tap “Close enough” again to reshuffle.

browse.title: All candidates
browse.sub: Browse everyone freely. Tap a candidate to see their positions and the evidence. To rank them against your own views, take the questionnaire.

about.title: About
about.aiNotice: Candidate positions here were researched with AI from public sources — interviews, votes, party platforms and press. That process is imperfect: positions may be out of date, miss context, or simply be wrong. Treat this as a starting point for your own reading, not a verdict. Every match shows the evidence it rests on, so you can check it.
about.author: Built by Itay Polack Gadassi
